title: OVERRIDE: claim gate still blocks background workers — task 20 fix is done-but-unmerged AND targets the wrong gate path
summary:
SPEC IS INCOMPLETE: the orch gate STILL refuses legit run_in_background Agent-tool worker claims as of 2026-06-15, despite task 091a4bf1/20 ("Fix touchAgent dropping agent_tool_spawn") being marked done. Two independent reasons, both verified this session.

(1) NEVER LANDED. Task 20's branch orch/attempt/091a4bf1-...-20 is still leased:true (unmerged). Its own summary flags that the prerequisite arm-(b) overlay precondition (routes/overlay.js) + agentToolSpawn detection (routes/exec.js) were UNCOMMITTED in the main working tree and absent from the branch base — part of the dormant audit-sprint tree (still uncommitted, daemon never restarted onto it). The live daemon runs the old code.

(2) WRONG GATE PATH. Task 20 patched the /overlay/status claim gate (routes/overlay.js arm (b): a.agent_tool_spawn && a.agent_id===b.agent_id). But the shell hook hooks/orch-gate.sh that blocks inline Edit/Write NEVER calls /overlay/status — it calls /active-claim and /session-info (routes/session.js). Those two endpoints have NO worktree-backed hookless-worker fallback. They reconcile a background worker only via agents[agent_id].subagent_session (session.js:25,33,54-59), which is never populated for run_in_background spawns because the SubagentStart hook does not fire for them.

ROOT MECHANISM of the live failure: a run_in_background worker inherits no SubagentStart, so it knows only the PARENT env CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID and registers its start_task claim under that parent id with subagent_session=null. The gate, invoked inside the worker's Edit, is handed the worker's OWN distinct hook session id (SUB != parent). /active-claim?session=SUB finds no claim (claim is under parent, bridges need subagent_session=SUB), /session-info?session=SUB returns is_subagent:false, so the gate concludes main/dispatcher and denies with "no in-flight workers".
